content.text: That sounds brutal, two hours of screaming at 2am would flatten anyone. Tonight, try going in calm and quiet, keeping the lights off and your words few, and stay close while he settles rather than picking him up or fully waking him. At 28 months, long middle-of-the-night screaming is common, and a steady, boring response tends to shorten it over time. If it keeps happening or something about it worries you, his pediatrician is worth a call.
